shared_elements: concentric circle / ringed disc in low relief
clustered arrangement of round motifs on a rounded, tapering stone body
shallow pecked low-relief carving over the whole surface
paired round elements flanking a central axis
justification: Both surfaces carry the same distinctive vocabulary of shallow, pecked low-relief concentric ringed discs combined with curling lobed/scroll forms clustered across the rounded upper body of a tapering monolith, and the carving conventions (broad flat outlines, no interior hatching, motifs floating on an undivided ground) are effectively identical, suggesting B could be a detail of the same scheme seen in A. The chief difference in depicted content is that A additionally shows a full anthropomorphic scheme with a head/headdress and a horizontal banded belt-like division below the chest, none of which appears in the partial view of B.
